title: Trump, Xi and Putin to hold first three-way meeting in China this week
caption:
The White House and the Kremlin have confirmed that Donald Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin will meet on Thursday in Shenzhen, on the sidelines of the APEC summit. It is the first meeting between the three leaders, and the White House says nuclear arms reduction will be the focus. US officials say Iran will be discussed but Ukraine will not, and they do not expect an agreement.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
